problem_statement: Endpoint-dependent replication acceptance tests fail through their generic precheck when SECOND_MINIO_ENDPOINT is unset instead of being treated as unavailable local test infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: When SECOND_MINIO_ENDPOINT is unset, every endpoint-dependent TestAccS3BucketReplication test skips with a short explanatory message.
When the replication endpoint is configured, the existing acceptance-test execution remains unchanged.

Do not alter Docker Compose configuration or tests that do not depend on replication endpoints.
Do not skip the endpoint-independent TestAccS3BucketReplication_attribute_migration unit-style regression test.
